status_note: An example showing every kind of requirement. Export it, change it, and import it as your own.
title: Example organisation policy (a template to copy)
instrument: Example: a firm's or tribunal's own rules for AI-assisted work
description: Shows a disclosure, a rule for the model, a reviewer confirmation, a note, a shorter status limit and forbidden terms.

requirements.title: Disclosure on every report
requirements.text: Every report carries the organisation's disclosure statement.
requirements.statement: Prepared with the assistance of ELI Legal, an AI system, and reviewed by a named person before reliance.

requirements.title: Defined terms
requirements.text: Use the documents' own defined terms.
requirements.instruction: Use the defined terms the documents use for the parties and the agreements.

requirements.title: Second reader
requirements.text: A second person reads every report before it is relied on.
requirements.statement: A second person has read this report before it is relied on.

requirements.title: Plain English
requirements.instruction: Write in plain English; avoid Latin phrases where an English one will do.

requirements.title: Firm-managed machines
requirements.text: Client data stays on machines the organisation manages.
